description: Simple A/B toggle every 20 seconds. The maze breathes on a fixed schedule. Learn the rhythm.

A.label: Base layout
A.description: The carved maze as generated — more open west corridor, primary path runs N→E→S.

B.label: Shifted layout
B.description: Opens east passage and southern shortcut. Closes the direct western approach. The lower half breathes.
B.note: Actual toggles are generated at runtime by generateSafeStateB(maze, seed+1, 6)

design.intent: Teach the player that the maze operates on a clock. The 20-second period is slow enough to feel safe, fast enough to matter mid-corridor.
playerLearning: Audio klaxon fires 5s before every shift
TTS confirms the schedule at start
Walls move visually — player can see them grind
Ghost wall alpha shows the old configuration for 1.8s
design.notes: No lies. No decoy exits. Dread multiplier reduced to 0.6. Ghost walls disabled for clarity.
